description:
We are honored to introduce Tunisian producer Khadija Al Hanafi to the world!

Her debut album "Slime Patrol" is a unique take on Footwork, blending Jazz/Soul/RnB with Lo-fi elements and Juke fundamentals.

Based in the capital and largest city of Tunisia, Khadija interprets Chicago's music through her own eyes. The eyes of a woman born and raised in Maghreb with a passion for Electronic Music and Black culture.

Teklife legend: DJ Earl stops by for a seal of approval on "Walk Wit Me", a meaningful track where they join forces as he invites her to follow his steps and welcomes her into a movement he is more than familiar with.

Fada Records grandpa and originator: Velvetian Sky is also part of the ride on "Baklava Dance Club" as well as NY Producer: Ted Kamal who chops and reworks "Youuuuu" turning it into a Club driven banger with complex rhythmics. 

Delicate, Organic and Playful, this album ventures into psychedelia and dance territories, making it perfectly adequate for headphone listens as much as dancefloor battles. 

Special High Energy music.
Sounds that'll make your feet fly and your head feel high!
